decisions.reason: GA4 became the current analytics standard in 2023, so this plugin fits the firm’s e-commerce stack, likely has ongoing client demand, and is inexpensive to keep while its full sales potential becomes clearer.

A Universal Analytics plugin lost most of its value once Google moved the market to GA4, so the results already reveal limited future upside and continued maintenance would tie up resources better used elsewhere.

A retail-system interface plugin matches the firm’s technical integration capabilities and customer needs, and with no clear negative signal yet it is worth keeping this option open because carrying costs are likely modest relative to its potential reuse across projects.

SEO support for shop relaunches is tightly complementary to the firm’s core service offering and can be delivered with existing staff, so it is sensible to keep it on the market while demand continues to be tested at low incremental cost.
